Class FloridianTeeth

java.lang.Object
FloridianTeeth
public class FloridianTeeth extends Object
Project 1 : Floridian Tooth Records program for the Florida Dental Association. Stores the teeth of each family member in a 3D char array. (person, upper/lower row, tooth number) and lets the user print the teeth, extract a tooth, or report the quadratic root canals.
